main_text.l: ONUS SEU PROPHETIA ROMÆ; Laurentio Hunfrido authore.

ROma superba licet, iudex uindexq; pi-orum, At Christi Domini discito iudici[?]. Dura licet, ferrum li fis, mollescito uer[?] si lapis & saxu, frangere Roma tamē (bis Audi Sodomæ princeps, Gomorrhaq; tota, Quisquis Romano de grege, quisquis erit Audi surda, & caeca tuas spectato ruinas, Hoc lege, quod pereas: aut sæpe, ne pereas. Roma rues, quondam uerae pietatis asylum, Musarum portus perfugiumq; choro. Roma uetus quondam multorum uecta per ora, Quam celebri Paulus prædicat elogio: Nunc sceleru sedes, nunc nunc erroris & ahtrū[?]. Degener ah nimium Roma nefanda rues. Roma rues, uirgo quondam, purissima uirgo, Cuius casta fides, integra religio, (tis, Intemerata thoro, thalamis non cognita mui[?] Vni sed sponso sponsa dicata Deo: Impia nunc Christo Domino diuortia scribens, Ac effrons meretrix, perfida Roma rues. Roma rues, mundi lux olim, stellaq; terræ: Nunc tenebræ, ac alto stella caduca polo. Cuius ad astra decus quondam sublime uolaq; Corruit, ac terræ est Tartarus Italia. (bat, Roma caput mundi, iam toto uertice calua, Capta tuis membris Roma misella rues. Ille cruore perit, qui fundit Roma cruorem[?])

page.notes: Title block and verse printed in roman type. Several readings are uncertain: "iudici[?]" (last letters worn), "uer[?]" (line end, cut off by the fold), "ahtrū[?]" (probably antrū), "mui[?]" (line end, probably muta or mui), "cruorem[?]" (end of last line). The parenthesised words "(bis", "(tis," and "(bat," are printed as they stand. The catchword "Sanꝰ" is followed by a printed mark ¶ that I did not include, since it is not a word. Hyphen at "pi-orum" is the printed line-end hyphen. No page number or running head is printed. Stains and show-through at the lower left are left out.
